posts.title: Dr. Varun's Advanced Endo-Spine Course 2026 – A Landmark in Minimally Invasive Spine Surgery
posts.excerpt: Bareilly International University (BIU) proudly hosted Dr. Varun's Advanced Endo-Spine Course 2026, bringing together leading spine surgeons across the globe...

eventDetails.venue: Rohilkhand Medical College & Hospital, Bareilly, Uttar Pradesh, India

quote.text: Thanks a lot, Dr. Varun, for a very nice, well-arranged advanced conference. We learned a lot during this conference and met expert pioneers in advanced endoscopic spine surgery. We will go back to our city again, thank you, Dr. Varun, for your generous hospitality. Thanks Bareilly, thanks India.
quote.author: Dr. Almutasimbellah

sections.heading: Event Overview
sections.content: Bareilly International University (BIU) proudly hosted Dr. Varun's Advanced Endo-Spine Course 2026, a pioneering event that brought together leading spine surgeons from across the globe to share, learn, and advance the frontiers of minimally invasive spine surgery. Held at Rohilkhand Medical College & Hospital, Bareilly, Uttar Pradesh, on 16th–17th July 2026, the course marked a milestone in India's medical education and surgical innovation.

sections.heading: A Global Platform for Surgical Excellence
sections.content:
The two day event featured live surgeries, hands-on cadaver training, and interactive sessions led by internationally acclaimed experts. Among the distinguished faculty was Dr. Hamid Abbasi, a renowned spine surgeon from the U.S., who conducted live demonstrations of advanced techniques such as OLLIF (Oblique Lateral Lumbar Interbody Fusion) and Trans Kambin Fusion — performed for the first time in India.

The course was meticulously organized under the leadership of Dr. Varun Agarwal, Endoscopic Spine Surgeon and Organising Secretary, whose vision was to create a collaborative platform where surgeons could exchange knowledge and refine their skills in endoscopic spine procedures.

sections.heading: Academic Exchange and Recognition
sections.content:
The inaugural ceremony witnessed eminent medical professionals and dignitaries felicitating Dr. Abbasi for his contribution to advanced instrumentation. The live surgery sessions offered real-time insights into minimally invasive approaches, emphasizing patient safety, faster recovery, and improved outcomes.

The cadaver workshop provided hands-on experience, allowing delegates to practice surgical techniques under expert supervision — a hallmark of BIU's commitment to experiential learning in medical education.

sections.heading: International Collaboration and Feedback
sections.content: The event drew delegates from multiple countries, including Iraq, where participants shared heartfelt feedback on the quality of clinical instruction and surgical demonstrations.

sections.heading: Launch Event and Celebration
sections.content: The course concluded with a grand launch ceremony, where Dr. Abbasi and Dr. Varun Agarwal unveiled a symbolic gift box representing innovation and partnership in spine surgery. The event blended academic rigor with celebration, highlighting the spirit of teamwork and progress that defines BIU's medical community.

sections.heading: Inspiring the Next Generation of Surgeons
sections.content: Dr. Varun's Advanced Endo-Spine Course 2026 exemplifies BIU's mission to empower healthcare professionals through advanced training and global exposure. With expert faculty, live demonstrations, and certification of participation, the program continues to inspire surgeons to adopt minimally invasive techniques and elevate patient care standards.

posts.title: Rohilkhand College of Nursing Marks World Heart Day 2026 with Awareness Programme...
posts.excerpt: Organised with the theme 'Don't Miss a Beat', faculty and nursing students led community screenings and CPR workshops...
posts.content: Rohilkhand College of Nursing organised a comprehensive public health awareness programme on the occasion of World Heart Day 2026 under the theme 'Don't Miss a Beat'. The event featured key lectures by senior cardiologists from Rohilkhand Hospital, live demonstrations of basic life support (BLS) and CPR techniques for public bystanders, and free cardiovascular health check-ups for campus staff and local communities.

posts.title: Dr. Medhavi Agarwal Honoured with Prestigious Amar Ujala Samarpan Samman...
posts.excerpt: Recognised for exemplary humanitarian contributions in clinical diagnostics and women health advocacy across the Rohilkhand region...
posts.content: Dr. Medhavi Agarwal of Bareilly International University was conferred the prestigious Amar Ujala Samarpan Samman in recognition of her tireless devotion to community healthcare, early oncology screening camps, and impactful leadership in clinical academic training. The award ceremony was attended by eminent dignitaries and healthcare leaders.

posts.title: Super Specialty Surgery: Elderly Cancer Patient Gets New Lease on Life...
posts.excerpt: A multidisciplinary team of surgeons and oncologists at Rohilkhand Medical College performed a high-risk 8-hour complex procedure...
posts.content: In a remarkable clinical milestone, the Department of Surgical Oncology and Anaesthesiology at Rohilkhand Medical College and Hospital successfully performed a complex 8-hour microvascular onco-reconstructive surgery on a 72-year-old cancer patient. The patient has recovered smoothly and was discharged with stable vitals, demonstrating the hospital's advanced tertiary care capabilities.

posts.title: Rohilkhand College of Nursing Celebrates M.Sc Nursing Farewell & Accolades...
posts.excerpt: Graduating postgraduates celebrated for clinical excellence, research publications, and national hospital placements...
posts.content: The outgoing batch of M.Sc Nursing students was felicitated during a vibrant valedictory ceremony at Rohilkhand College of Nursing. Senior faculty commended the scholars for their outstanding clinical rotations during epidemic management and recognized top paper presenters with university merit certificates.

posts.title: ARISE Symposium for BIU Faculty & Clinical Scholars...
posts.excerpt: Dr. Onkar N. Tiwari, Department of Biotechnology and Clinical Research presented key findings on precision diagnostic algorithms...
posts.content: The annual ARISE Research Symposium brought together faculty members, doctoral fellows, and resident physicians to deliberate on translational medical research, intellectual property filing, and high-throughput data analysis in modern clinical pathology.

posts.title: BIU Campus Placement Drive 2026 Achieves Record Package...
posts.excerpt: Bareilly International University placement cell achieves record recruitment offers across medical, pharmacy, nursing, and management streams...
posts.content: The Central Training & Placement Cell concluded the 2026 Annual Recruitment Drive with stellar placements in multinational pharmaceuticals, tertiary hospital chains, healthcare analytics firms, and corporate consultancies, marking a 32% year-over-year increase in top-tier placement offers.

posts.title: A Glimpse into Progressive Medical Research: AI & Care...
posts.excerpt: With the aim of promoting cutting-edge research across various healthcare fields, Rohilkhand Medical College inaugurates AI lab...
posts.content: Rohilkhand Medical College has established a dedicated Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare incubation laboratory to accelerate deep learning-assisted radiological imaging, pathology slide analysis, and tele-triage systems for rural health centers.

posts.title: BIU Expands Strategic Global Academic Alliances & MoUs...
posts.excerpt: In a significant stride towards strengthening global healthcare and research collaboration, BIU signs MoU with leading international bodies...
posts.content: BIU formalized international academic partnerships with premier medical and pharmaceutical institutions across the UK and Asia to facilitate student-faculty exchange programmes, joint grant writing, and collaborative dual-degree initiatives.

posts.title: Annual National Medical Conclave Hosted at BIU Auditorium...
posts.excerpt: Over 500 leading doctors and surgeons from across India gathered for keynote surgical workshops and clinical diagnostics sessions...
posts.content: Over 500 medical professionals attended the three-day National Medical Conclave hosted by BIU. Key topics included robotic laparoscopic surgery, antimicrobial resistance protocols, and organ transplantation advancements.

posts.title: Inter-Collegiate Annual Sports Meet Concludes with Grand Gala...
posts.excerpt: Students from medical, pharmacy, nursing, and dental faculties competed in athletics, football, basketball, and badminton tournaments...
posts.content: The university stadium witnessed electrifying competition across 18 athletic disciplines during the week-long Inter-Collegiate Annual Sports Meet. Rohilkhand Medical College lifted the overall championship trophy amid spirited student celebrations.

posts.title: Advanced Botanical Medicinal Garden Inaugurated on Campus...
posts.excerpt: The Department of Dravyaguna inaugurates a state-of-the-art research garden cultivating over 300 rare Himalayan healing herbs...
posts.content: Spanning over 5 lush acres, the new medicinal botanical garden houses rare therapeutic flora for pharmacognosy research, standardisation of Ayurvedic formulations, and experiential learning for BAMS scholars.

posts.title: Free Rural Healthcare & Dental Camps Benefiting Thousands...
posts.excerpt: Rohilkhand Medical College doctors conducted comprehensive free health checkups and medicine distributions across 12 rural blocks...
posts.content: As part of its institutional social responsibility, BIU's mobile medical units and dental clinics provided free diagnostic tests, dental checkups, and free medicines to more than 4,500 underprivileged villagers across Western Uttar Pradesh.
